notes: expect/actual wrapper class around a platform soft reference (JVM actual impl in SoftRef.jvm.kt wraps `java.lang.ref.SoftReference<T>`). get() simply delegates to `ref.get()` and returns the referent or null if the GC has reclaimed it. Confirmed use as a cache-eviction primitive: SoftCacheEntryReference.kt and SoftKeyedCacheEntryReference.kt both store `SoftRef<Any?>(object)` and presumably call get() to fetch the cached object, allowing the JVM to reclaim memory-cache entries under pressure. Name is already idiomatic (mirrors Java's SoftReference.get()/Kotlin's own naming) so kept as-is.
